40021802.author: पदार्थः
40021802.content: सीताम् Sita, तु indeed, रुदतीम् crying, दृष्ट्वा having seen, ते those, तत्र there, मुनिदारकाः hermit boys, प्राद्रवन् ran, यत्र where, भगवान् revered, आस्ते resides, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, उग्रधीः of keen intellect.

40021802.author: Translation
40021802.content: Seeing Sita crying there, the hermit boys ran to where the revered Valmiki, of keen intellect, resided.

40021803.author: पदार्थः
40021803.content: अभिवाद्य having saluted, मुनेः of the sage, पादौ feet, मुनिपुत्राः hermit boys, महर्षये to the great sage, सर्वम् all, निवेदयामासुः reported, तस्याः her, तु indeed, रुदितस्वनम् sound of crying.

40021803.author: Translation
40021803.content: Having saluted the feet of the great sage, the hermit boys reported to him everything about her crying.

40021804.author: पदार्थः
40021804.content: अदृष्टपूर्वा never seen before, भगवन् O venerable one, कस्यापि of some, एषा this, महात्मनः great soul, पत्नी wife, श्रीरिव like Lakshmi, सम्मोहात् due to great distress, विरौति cries out, विकृतानना with a distorted face.

40021804.author: Translation
40021804.content: O venerable one, this woman, never seen before, the wife of some great soul, cries out with a distorted face as if Lakshmi herself were deluded and wailing.

40021805.author: पदार्थः
40021805.content: भगवन् O venerable one, साधु properly, पश्य behold, त्वं you, देवतामिव like a goddess, खात् from the sky, च्युताम् fallen, नद्यास्तु of the river, indeed, तीरे on the bank, भगवन् O venerable one, वरस्त्री an excellent woman, कापि some, दुःखिता distressed.

40021805.author: Translation
40021805.content: O venerable one, please observe carefully this excellent woman on the river bank, who appears distressed as if a goddess has fallen from the sky.

40021806.author: पदार्थः
40021806.content: दृष्टा seen, अस्माभिः by us, प्ररुदिता weeping profusely, दृढं intensely, शोकपरायणा overcome by grief, अनर्हा undeserving, दुःखशोकाभ्याम् of sorrow and grief, एकां alone, दीनां miserable, हि indeed, अनाथवत् like an orphan.

40021806.author: Translation
40021806.content: We have seen her weeping profusely, intensely overcome by grief, alone and miserable like an orphan, though she is undeserving of such sorrow and grief.

40021807.author: पदार्थः
40021807.content: न not, हि indeed, एनां her, मानुषीं a human woman, विद्मः we know, सत्क्रिया proper reception, अस्याः to her, प्रयुज्यताम् let it be offered, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरे near, च and, त्वाम् you, इयं this, शरणं refuge, गता has sought.

40021807.author: Translation
40021807.content: Indeed, we do not believe her to be a human woman, so let proper hospitality be offered to her, as she has come seeking refuge with you near the hermitage.

40021808.author: पदार्थः
40021808.content: त्रातारम् a protector, इच्छते desires, साध्वी the virtuous woman, भगवन् O venerable one, त्रातुम् to protect, अर्हसि you ought, तेषां their, तु indeed, वचनं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, बुद्ध्या with intellect, निश्चित्य having ascertained, धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, तपसा by asceticism, लब्धचक्षुष्मान् one who has gained spiritual sight, प्राद्रवत् rushed, यत्र where, मैथिली Maithili.

40021808.author: Translation
40021808.content: The virtuous woman desires a protector, O venerable one, and you ought to protect her; having heard their words, the knower of dharma, who had gained spiritual sight through asceticism, ascertained the situation with his intellect and rushed to where Maithili was.

40021809.author: पदार्थः
40021809.content: तम् him, प्रयान्तम् going, अभिप्रेत्य having perceived, शिष्याः disciples, हि indeed, एनम् this, महामतिम् great-minded one (Valmiki); तम् that, तु but, देशम् place, अभि towards, प्रेत्य having gone, किञ्चित् a little, पद्भ्याम् by feet, महामतिः the great-minded one (Valmiki).

40021809.author: Translation
40021809.content: The great sage Valmiki, perceived by his disciples as he was departing, proceeded a short distance on foot towards a particular spot.

40021810.author: पदार्थः
40021810.content: अर्घ्यम् offering, आदाय having taken, रुचिरम् beautiful, जाह्नवीतीरम् the bank of the Ganga, आगमत् he came; ददर्श he saw, राघवस्य of Rama, इष्टाम् beloved, सीताम् Sita, पत्नीम् wife, अनाथवत् like one without a protector.

40021810.author: Translation
40021810.content: Having taken a beautiful offering, Valmiki arrived at the bank of the Ganga and there saw Sita, Rama's beloved wife, appearing helpless and unprotected.

40021811.author: पदार्थः
40021811.content: ताम् that, सीताम् Sita, शोकभारार्ताम् afflicted by the burden of sorrow, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, उवाच he spoke, मधुराम् sweet, वाणीम् words, ह्लादयन् as if gladdening, इव as if, तेजसा with his spiritual radiance.

40021811.author: Translation
40021811.content: The foremost sage Valmiki spoke sweet words to that Sita, who was afflicted by the burden of sorrow, as if comforting her with his spiritual radiance.

40021812.author: पदार्थः
40021812.content: स्नुषा daughter-in-law, दशरथस्य of Dasharatha, त्वम् you, रामस्य of Rama, महिषी queen, प्रिया beloved, जनकस्य of Janaka, सुता daughter, राज्ञः of the king; स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, पतिव्रते O chaste wife.

40021812.author: Translation
40021812.content: Valmiki addressed Sita, saying, "You are the daughter-in-law of Dasharatha, the beloved queen of Rama, and the daughter of King Janaka; welcome to you, O chaste wife."

40021813.author: पदार्थः
40021813.content: आयान्ती coming, च and, असि you are, विज्ञाता known, मया by me, धर्मसमाधिना through my meditation on dharma; कारणम् reason, च and, एव indeed, सर्वम् all, मे by me, हृदयेन by heart, उपलक्षितम् understood.

40021813.author: Translation
40021813.content: Valmiki further stated, "You, as you were coming, were known to me through my meditation on dharma, and indeed, all the reasons for your arrival have been discerned by my heart."

40021814.author: पदार्थः
40021814.content: तव your, च and, एव indeed, महाभागे O highly fortunate one, विदितं known, मम to me, तत्त्वतः truly; सर्वं all, च and, विदितं known, मह्यं to me, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यत् whatever, हि indeed, वर्तते exists.

40021814.author: Translation
40021814.content: O highly fortunate one, your true nature is indeed known to me, and everything that exists in the three worlds is also known to me.

40021815.author: पदार्थः
40021815.content: अपापां sinless, वेद्मि I know, सीते O Sita, त्वां you, तपोलब्धेन obtained through asceticism, चक्षुषा by the eye; विस्रब्धा confident, भव be, वैदेहि O Vaidehi, साम्प्रतं now, मयि in me, वर्तसे you reside.

40021815.author: Translation
40021815.content: O Sita, I know you to be sinless through the eye of wisdom gained by my penance; O Vaidehi, be confident, for you are now under my protection.

40021816.author: पदार्थः
40021816.content: आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरे not far, मे my, तापस्यः female ascetics, तपसि in penance, स्थिताः engaged; ताः they, त्वां you, वत्से O dear child, यथा as, वत्सं a calf, पालयिष्यन्ति will protect, नित्यशः always.

40021816.author: Translation
40021816.content: Not far from my hermitage, there are female ascetics engaged in penance, and they, O dear child, will always protect you as a mother protects her calf.

40021817.author: पदार्थः
40021817.content: इदं this, अर्ध्यं offering, प्रतीच्छ accept, त्वं you, विस्रब्धा confident, विगतज्वरा free from distress; यथा as if, स्वगृहं your own home, अभ्येत्य having reached, विषादं sorrow, च and, एव indeed, मा do not, कृथाः make.

40021817.author: Translation
40021817.content: Accept this offering, confident and free from distress, and do not feel any sorrow, as if you have come to your own home.

40021818.author: पदार्थः
40021818.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, भाषितं the words, सीता Sita, मुनेः of the sage, परमं supremely, अद्भुतम् wonderful; शिरसा with her head, आवन्द्य having bowed down to, चरणौ the two feet, तथा so be it, इति thus, आह said, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands.

40021818.author: Translation
40021818.content: Having heard the supremely wonderful words of the sage, Sita, with folded hands, bowed down to his feet with her head and said, "So be it."

40021819.author: पदार्थः
40021819.content: तम् him, प्रयान्तम् departing, मुनिम् sage, सीता Sita, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, पृष्ठतः from behind, अन्वगात् followed.

40021819.author: Translation
40021819.content: Sita, with folded hands, followed the departing sage from behind.

40021820.author: पदार्थः
40021820.content: तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मुनिम् sage, आयान्तम् coming, वैदेह्या with Vaidehi, मुनिपत्नयः wives of sages, उपाजग्मुः approached, मुदा with joy, युक्ताः filled, वचनम् words, च and, इदम् these, अब्रुवन् spoke.

40021820.author: Translation
40021820.content: Seeing the sage approaching with Vaidehi, the wives of the sages, filled with joy, came forward and spoke these words.

40021821.author: पदार्थः
40021821.content: स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, मुनिश्रेष्ठ O best of sages, चिरस्य after a long time, आगमनम् arrival, च and, ते your, अभिवादयामः we salute, त्वाम् you, सर्वाः all, उच्यताम् tell us, किम् what, च and, कुर्महे we should do.

40021821.author: Translation
40021821.content: "Welcome to you, O best of sages; your arrival is after a long time; all of us salute you, please tell us what we should do."

40021822.author: पदार्थः
40021822.content: तासाम् their, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke, सीता Sita, इयम् this, समनुप्राप्ता has arrived, पत्नी wife, रामस्य of Rama, धीमतः the wise.

40021822.author: Translation
40021822.content: Having heard their words, Valmiki spoke this: "This is Sita, the wife of the wise Rama, who has arrived."

40021823.author: पदार्थः
40021823.content: स्नुषा daughter-in-law, दशरथस्य of Dasharatha, एषा she, जनकस्य of Janaka, सुता daughter, सती chaste, अपापा sinless, पतिना by her husband, त्यक्ता abandoned, परिपाल्या to be protected, मया by me, सदा always.

40021823.author: Translation
40021823.content: "She is the daughter-in-law of Dasharatha and the chaste daughter of Janaka; though sinless, she has been abandoned by her husband and must always be protected by me."

40021824.author: पदार्थः
40021824.content: इमां her, भवन्त्यः you (feminine plural), पश्यन्तु may you regard, स्नेहेन with affection, परमेण supreme, हि indeed, गौरवात् out of respect, मम my, वाक्यात् from words, च and, पूज्या worthy of worship, वः for you, अस्तु let her be, विशेषतः especially.

40021824.author: Translation
40021824.content: Indeed, may you all regard her with supreme affection, and especially, let her be worthy of your reverence out of respect for my words.

40021825.author: पदार्थः
40021825.content: मुहुर्मुहुः repeatedly, च and, वैदेहीं Vaidehi, प्रणिधाय having entrusted, महायशाः the greatly renowned, स्वम् his own, आश्रमं hermitage, शिष्यवृतः surrounded by disciples, पुनः again, आयात् returned, महातपाः the great ascetic.

40021825.author: Translation
40021825.content: And having repeatedly entrusted Vaidehi, the greatly renowned and great ascetic Valmiki, surrounded by his disciples, returned to his own hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 49 ।। Thus ends the forty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
